start_here.title: Compare the same takedown label in two environments
start_here.task: Find the open-floor Kosoto heading in Volume 1 and the cage Kosoto heading in Volume 2. Record the environmental difference each lesson promises to address. When watching footage you have access to, mark whether the exchange begins beside a boundary before deciding which lesson to study.
